title: Running a Boolean Program
statement: Given a function $F$ that assigns a list of output bits to each instruction kind and list of input bits, an input list $x$, a list of instructions, and an initial list of bit blocks, process the instructions in order. At each instruction, evaluate its ordered source list using $x$ and the blocks computed so far, apply $F$ with that instruction's kind, and append the resulting block to the list; the resulting list is the program run.
hypotheses_covered: function F from an instruction kind and a Boolean list to a Boolean list
